# ERS TECH

> ERS TECH is a leading custom software development and IT consulting company specializing in enterprise software, fintech solutions, mobile applications, web development, and blockchain technologies. With over a decade of experience and a team of 50+ technology experts, ERS TECH delivers scalable, secure, and future-ready digital solutions to businesses worldwide.

## Key Sections

- [About Us](https://erstech.org/about-us): Learn about our mission, vision, values, 10+ years of experience, and leadership in software innovation.
- [Services](https://erstech.org/services): Custom web development, mobile app development, enterprise software, UI/UX design, QA testing, blockchain engineering, and cloud consulting.
- [Portfolio](https://erstech.org/portfolio): Case studies and delivered projects across fintech, healthcare, blockchain, and enterprise SaaS applications.
- [Pricing](https://erstech.org/pricing): Flexible engagement models including dedicated engineering teams, fixed-price contracts, and hourly/milestone billing.
- [Careers](https://erstech.org/careers): Current career opportunities for senior developers, UI/UX designers, QA engineers, and project managers.
- [Blogs](https://erstech.org/blogs): In-depth articles, engineering guides, and industry analyses on web development, mobile frameworks, and blockchain innovation.
